svg.title: 无人机视角单目标跟踪的时序感知选层
svg.desc: One image crop and the fixed template share SGLA L1 through L6. A risk gate determines whether to replace the original layer with the pairwise-ranked alternative. A dashed 16-frame cooldown box marks the pending Stage-170 test. Each frame executes one independent late block. Photos are illustrative crops from the attributed v5 asset.
